motivation: The prespecified COCO baseline failed. Test a single bounded domain-specific fine-tune, with no training or threshold choice using evaluation-flight labels.
training_pool: Six flights drawn only from the original eight calibration flights
calibration_pool: Two nonempty original calibration flights, selected by seeded shuffle before training
evaluation_disclosure: Baseline aggregate failures and selected error overlays were seen before this follow-up. This is a follow-up on a known benchmark, not a fresh blind external test.
checkpoint: last fixed epoch; no evaluation-based checkpoint selection
tile_labels: Clip all intersecting source boxes to the tile; overlapping tiles share a source image's partition
initial_weights: Official YOLOv8n COCO, same verified hash as baseline
inference: 1024-pixel tiles, 20 percent overlap, 1024 model input, global NMS IoU 0.5
selection_objective: Minimum calibration FP plus FN, then count MAE, then higher confidence
human_timing: Still requires an actual participant; proxy improvements do not establish time saved
